= Checklist Overview = 

I got tired of switching back and forth between all the different quest pages, so I decided to consolidate them into one checklist. 

= Temple of Solusek Ro Armor =
The Temple of Solusek Ro is located in [[Lavastorm]]

== '''[[Circlet of Mist]]''' ==

This quest begins with a High Elf named [[Joyce]] in the Temple of Solusek Ro.

==== Checklist ====

{{CheckboxList}}
* [[Globe of Mist]] (from [[A Festering Hag]] in [[The Estate of Unrest]]).
* [[Water Ring]] (from [[Aqua goblin tidal lord]] in [[Dagnor's Cauldron]]).
* [[Ring of Evoluoy]] ( from [[An alligator]] in [[Cazic Thule]])
* [[Sapphire]], bought from jewelry merchants for as little as 105pp.
{{end}}

== '''[[Clay Bracelet]]''' ==

This quest begins with a High Elf named [[Joyce]] in the Temple of Solusek Ro.

==== Checklist ====

{{CheckboxList}}

*[[Rune of Clay]] (Right) - From [[Bindlegrob]] in [[Rathe Mountains]]
*[[Rune of Clay]] (Left) - From [[Sindlegrob]] in [[Rathe Mountains]]

= Magician Focus Items =

The Temple of Solusek Ro is located in [[Lavastorm]]

== '''[[Broom of Trilon]]''' ==

This quest begins with a Gnome named [[Vira]] in the Temple of Solusek Ro.

This quest begins with a High Elf named [[Joyce]] in the Temple of Solusek Ro.

==== Checklist ====

{{CheckboxList}}
* [[Star Ruby]] may be purchased from a jewelry merchant
* [[Griffon Feathers]] drop from various griffins worldwide.
* [[A Broom]] (identifies as "Broom of Air") drops from magicians in [[Najena]] or alligators in [[Cazic_Thule_(Zone)]] or [[Lake Rathetear]].
* [[Cyclops Toes]] drop from various cyclops worldwide.
{{end}}

== '''[[Shovel of Ponz]]''' ==

This quest begins with a Gnome named [[Vira]] in the Temple of Solusek Ro.

==== Checklist ====

{{CheckboxList}}
* [[Ruby]] may be purchased from a jewelry merchant.
* [[Gargoyle Eye]] drops from various gargoyles worldwide.
* [[A Shovel]] (identifies as "Shovel of Earth". Careful not to confuse with [[Shovel]]!) drops from magicians in [[Najena]] or alligators in [[Cazic_Thule_(Zone)]].
* [[Hill Giant Toes]] drop from various hill giants worldwide.
{{end}}

== '''[[Stein of Ulissa]]''' ==

This quest begins with a Gnome named [[Vira]] in the Temple of Solusek Ro.

==== Checklist ====

{{CheckboxList}}
* [[Sapphire]] may be purchased from a jewelry merchant. 
* [[Mermaid Scale]] drops from various mermaids worldwide. 
* [[Stein (of Water)]] drops from magicians in [[Najena]] or alligators in [[Cazic_Thule_(Zone)|Cazic Thule]] or [[Lake Rathetear]].
* [[Ice Giant Toes]] drop from various ice giants around the old world (everfrost, permafrost, [[Gornit]] in ocean of tears). These are not to be confused with [[Frost Giant Toes]], which drop from Velious giants.
{{end}}

== '''[[Torch of Alna]]''' ==

This quest begins with a Gnome named [[Vira]] in the Temple of Solusek Ro.

==== Checklist ====

{{CheckboxList}}
* [[Fire Emerald]] may be purchased from a jewelry merchant
* [[Fire Drake Scale]] drops from various fire drakes in the [[Lavastorm Mountains]] and [[Solusek's Eye]] (Sol A)
* [[A Torch]] (not just "Torch", identifies as "Torch of Fire") drops from the magicians and goblin magicians in [[Najena]] or alligators in [[Cazic_Thule_(Zone)]] or [[Lake Rathetear]].
* [[Fire Giant Toes]] drop from various fire giants worldwide.
{{end}}
